suite: Explicit grouped current/local observation conflict review
environment: Actual TypeScript helper with synthetic context/fact fixtures
limits: No clinical, server authority, durable offline or formal acceptance inferred.

checks.label: Original local and current evidence are distinct retained copies
No unchanged group invents a conflict
Contradictory edits identify a collision
Identical edits do not invent contradictory evidence
Every changed group requires a choice
An invalid automatic choice cannot qualify
Explicit local weight plus saved notes preserves both reviewed intents
Neither original local nor saved input is mutated
Adopted output does not alias retained review
Paired blood pressure is one indivisible group
Chosen original unit reason source and time stay with the value
Selected absence never becomes a recorded normal measurement
Global fallback cannot silently redate a chosen local value
Global fallback cannot silently change chosen source
Explicit own source and time permit a semantically faithful mix
Adopting every saved group reproduces actual saved facts
Changed organisation cannot qualify a review
Changed person cannot qualify a review
Changed person-version cannot qualify a review
Changed visit cannot qualify a review
Changed lower-version cannot qualify a review
Changed confirmed cannot qualify a review
Changed voided cannot qualify a review
Changed superseded cannot qualify a review
Changed captured-range cannot qualify a review
Changed captured-pack cannot qualify a review
Malformed missing-weight is unavailable rather than defaulted
Malformed numeric-weight is unavailable rather than defaulted
Malformed unknown-field is unavailable rather than defaulted
Malformed invalid-source is unavailable rather than defaulted
Malformed array-notes is unavailable rather than defaulted
Same complete reviewed checkpoint can be adopted
A newer saved version invalidates affirmation
Changed facts even at a repeated version refuse
Changed programme answers invalidate the checkpoint
Property insertion order never invents a conflict
